data.title: Eywa Tower
data.about:
Explore the remarkable Eywa by R Evolution in the bustling heart of Business Bay, Dubai. Eywa Dubai introduces an exclusive collection of 48 units, comprising 2 to 5 bedroom apartments and 2 unique penthouses, each designed with a focus on community well-being, natural living, and positive energy. 

The strategic Eywa Dubai Location merges ancient wisdom with modern technology and world-class architecture, fostering an environment that promotes harmony and well-being. Choose Eywa Apartments and Penthouses for a living experience that goes beyond the ordinary. 

At Eywa Tower Dubai, every detail is crafted to enrich your life, offering an organic, imaginative, and immersive way of living. Don't miss this opportunity to be part of Eywa Business Bay – a place where your soul, health, and well-being can truly flourish.

characteristics_module.title: Reside in the tree of life at Eywa Tower Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Inspired by the Banyan tree and Hallelujah mountains from "Avatar".
  • Timeless wisdom and enduring growth symbolism.
  • Special air purification filters and natural oil aromas.
  • Private swimming pool in each apartment.
  • Energy inducing crystal and stone gardens in public spaces.
  • Mesmerizing views of the  Business Bay Dubai Water Canal and skyline.
  • 4-level car park blending nature and comfort.
  • Personal waterfalls in select apartments.
  • Eywa will be LEED Platinum, WELL Platinum and HealthTechPro certified.
  • Vastu Shastra experts' advice on choosing and placing crystals in an apartment for family well-being.

location_tile.title: Spectacular Living at Eywa Tower in Business Bay!
location_tile.heading: Eywa Location
location_tile.description:
Step into the world of Eywa by R Evolution in Business Bay Dubai, a prestigious development poised elegantly on the Dubai Water Canal's edge. This prime Eywa Dubai location in the illustrious Business Bay ensures swift access to the city's pulse points via Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. 

Experience luxury living with nearby amenities including the Grand Millennium Business Bay hotel, Gulf Court Hotel Business Bay, and the delightful Bella Restaurant & Lounge for Italian cuisine aficionados.  Furthermore, Eywa's proximity to Dubai International Airport, only 15 minutes away, offers effortless travel for residents, positioning Eywa Tower Dubai as a coveted destination for discerning individuals.

  • Burj Khalifa/ Dubai Mall - 8 Mins
  • Jumeirah Beach - 10 Mins
  • Mall of Emirates - 10 Mins
  • DIFC - 12 Mins
  • Dubai Marina - 15 Mins
  • Burj Al Arab- 15 Mins
